tools.name: registry-intelligence_fdic-bankfind-lookup
tools.description: Search the vendored FDIC institutions snapshot by name, certificate number, city, or state. Returns candidate matches from the snapshot only. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/registry-intelligence/fdic-bankfind-lookup. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "registry-intelligence" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: registry-intelligence_fdic-bankfind-lookup · Public sink: registry-intelligence_fdic-bankfind-lookup · Destructive: registry-intelligence_fdic-bankfind-lookup.
findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
